title: TensorSharp typed local regression scenario profiles
description: Common input envelope only. The Python loader also resolves catalog identities, checks unique profile IDs and local paths, validates finite budgets, and invokes the scenario executor's strict validate_profile function. Schema validation alone does not establish an executable, safe, supported or passing profile.

catalog_reference.description: Exact existing catalog preset ID; membership is checked by the loader.

path.description: Local regular file. Relative paths resolve against the profile document directory; URL and UNC paths are refused. The loader caps each fixture at 512 MiB and executors apply smaller format/geometry limits.

ram_required_gib.description: Explicit combined peak host RAM for the primary model, every resident role, staging and workspace; not a measured fit guarantee.

vram_required_gib.description: Required for a GPU backend. Omit for CPU rather than supplying zero.

per_gpu_required_gib.description: Separate physical-device requirements. Multi-GPU executors require an entry for each selected GPU; free VRAM is checked independently with headroom, never pooled.

scratch_gib.description: Output-volume workspace/artifact allowance, checked separately from model-cache transfer bytes. Omit when no additional allowance is requested.

id.description: Must be unique across the document; result ID is profile::<id>.

preset.description: An exact catalog preset ID; identifies the implicit primary role. native_unit uses it only for selection/classification and does not load its model.

models.description: Executor-defined role -> exact catalog preset ID. The executor restricts admitted roles; an explicit primary, where admitted, must equal preset. Never a URL or command.

parameters.description: Strict scenario-specific fields are validated by the selected executor; arbitrary commands/endpoints are not a generic capability of this schema.

expected.description: Independent approved oracle and scenario-specific numerical/semantic gates; validated by the selected executor.
